summary: Comprehensive testing of Halaman Akun (Emergent Google Auth) feature + BeritaPage distinct category icons. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed — invalid session_id → 401; /auth/me no creds → 401; /auth/me with Bearer returns full user shape; /user/favorites/{id} toggles correctly and GET /user/favorites returns hydrated snapshots; public /submissions/kontak still returns {ok,id}; when session_token cookie present, submission record has user_id stamped (verified via admin /submissions); /user/submissions returns items linked by payload.email; /auth/logout deletes session and subsequent /auth/me → 401. Frontend: /login renders Bahasa Indonesia 'Lanjutkan dengan Google' with data-testid; button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>%2Fauth%2Fcallback (URL correctly constructed). After setting session_token cookie: /akun renders user name+email in hero, 3 tabs (Profil/Favorit/Riwayat) switch content, akun-logout-button visible, Favorit tab displays clickable /properti/{id} cards, Riwayat tab shows CTA to /konsultasi. Header shows header-account-btn (with avatar) when logged in; dropdown reveals menu-akun-profil + header-logout-btn; clicking header-logout-btn logs user out and reverts Header to Masuk/Daftar. Heart on ListingCard: when NOT logged in → redirects to /login; when logged in → POST /api/user/favorites/{id} returns 200 {ok:true,favorited:...} and change persists (GET /api/user/favorites reflects state). BeritaPage sidebar: all 9 categories (Semua, Panduan, KPR, Legal, Tips, Investasi, Keuangan, Subsidi, Keamanan) render 9 DISTINCT lucide-react SVG icons.
critical_code_review_comments: user_routes.py cleanly implements Emergent Google Auth playbook (X-Session-ID exchange, httpOnly+secure+sameSite=None cookie, Bearer fallback, expires_at TZ handling).
admin_routes.py public /submissions/{type} correctly stamps user_id when session_token cookie present without breaking anonymous flow.
BeritaPage CAT_ICONS map covers all currently-used categories; consider defaulting future categories to BookOpen (already done).
AuthContext intentionally skips /auth/me when URL fragment has session_id — correctly documented; verified in flow.
